Wave Incense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is incense with a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.
Rose Incense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is an exotic-smelling incense that boosts the power of Grass-type moves.
Luck Incense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle's prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.
Pure Incense: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the first one in the party.
Protector: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.
Electirizer: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.
Magmarizer: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.
Dubious Disc: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data. Its producer is unknown.
Reaper Cloth: A cloth imbued with horrifyingly strong spiritual energy. It is loved by a certain Pokémon.
Razor Claw: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a sharply hooked claw that ups the holder's critical-hit ratio.
Razor Fang: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It may make foes and allies flinch when the holder inflicts damage.
Explorer Kit: A bag filled with convenient tools for exploring. It provides access to the Underground.
Loot Sack: A sturdy, spacious bag that is used to carry loot obtained in the coal mine.
Rule Book: It lists the rules for holding battles. For linked battles, you may choose which set of rules you wish to use.
Poké Radar: A tool that can search out Pokémon that are hiding in grass. Its battery is recharged as you walk.
Point Card: A card that lists the Battle Points you have earned.
Journal: A notebook that keeps a day-to-day record of your adventure so far.
Seal Case: A case for storing Seals that can be applied to the Capsule cases of Poké Balls.
Fashion Case: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.
Seal Bag: A tiny bag that can hold 10 Seals for decorating Poké Balls.
Pal Pad: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.
Works Key: A large key for operating the doors of the Valley Windworks in the canyon. It was held by a Team Galactic Grunt.
Old Charm: An ancient good-luck charm made of Pokémon bones to be taken to the elder of Celestic Town.
Galactic Key: A card key for disengaging security systems in the Galactic HQ. Losing it can result in punishment, apparently.
Red Chain: A mythical chain that is said to link the legendary Pokémon that created the Sinnoh region.
Town Map: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.
Vs. Seeker: A device that indicates Trainers who want to battle. Its battery charges while you walk.
Coin Case: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 50,000 coins.
Old Rod: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
Good Rod: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
Super Rod: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.
Sprayduck: A watering can shaped like a Psyduck. It helps promote healthy growth of Berries planted in soft soil.
Poffin Case: A case for storing Poffin cooked from Berries.
Bicycle: A folding Bicycle that enables much faster movement than the Running Shoes.
Suite Key: A key to one of the suites at the luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.
Oak's Letter: A letter from Prof. Oak. Written in it is a request for you to go to Rt. 224.
Lunar Wing: A feather that glows like the moon. It is said to possess the power to dispel nightmares.
Member Card: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.
Azure Flute: A flute that puts out echoing sounds that do not seem to be of this world. It is unknown who made it.
S.S. Ticket: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Aqua. It has a drawing of a ship on it.
Contest Pass: The pass required for entering Pokémon Contests. It has a drawing of an award ribbon on it.
Magma Stone: A stone formed when boulders melted in intensely hot magma, then hardened. Magma remains sealed inside.
Parcel: A parcel entrusted in your care. You are supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.
Coupon 1: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.
Coupon 2: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.
Coupon 3: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch (Pokétch for short). Three coupons are needed.
Storage Key: The key to Team Galactic's sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.
Secret Potion: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.
Vs. Recorder: An amazing device that can record a battle either between friends or at a special battle facility.
Gracidea: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.
Secret Key: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electric signal to open a door.
Apricorn Box: A handy box where you can store up to 99 Apricorns of each kind.
Unown Report: A report of all the discovered kinds of Unown.
Berry Pots: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.
Dowsing Machine: It checks for unseen items in the area and makes noise and lights when it finds something.
Blue Card: A card to save points for the Buena's Password show.
Slowpoke Tail: A very tasty tail of something. It sells for a high price.
Clear Bell: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.
Card Key: A card key that opens a shutter in the Radio Tower.
Basement Key: A key that opens a door in the Goldenrod Tunnel.
Squirt Bottle: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.
Red Scale: A scale from the red Gyarados. It glows red like a flame.
Lost Item: The Mime Jr. doll that was lost by the Copycat.
Pass: A ticket required for riding the Magnet Train. It allows you to ride whenever and however much you'd like.
Machine Part: An important machine part for the Power Plant that was stolen.
Silver Wing: A strange, silvery feather that sparkles.
Rainbow Wing: A mystical rainbow feather that sparkles.
Mystery Egg: A mysterious Egg obtained from Mr. Pokémon. What's in the Egg is unknown.
Red Apricorn: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.
Blu Apricorn: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.
Ylw Apricorn: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.
Grn Apricorn: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.
Pnk Apricorn: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.
Wht Apricorn: A white Apricorn. It doesn't smell like anything.
Blk Apricorn: A black Apricorn It has an indescribable scent.
Fast Ball: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon which are quick to run away.
Level Ball: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are a lower level than your own.
Lure Ball: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon hooked by a Rod when fishing.
Heavy Ball: A Poké Ball for catching very heavy Pokémon.
Love Ball: Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that are the opposite gender of your Pokémon.
Friend Ball: A Poké Ball that makes caught Pokémon more friendly.
Moon Ball: A Poké Ball for catching Pokémon that evolve using the Moon Stone.
Sport Ball: A special Poké Ball for the Bug-Catching Contest.
Park Ball: A special Poké Ball for the Pal Park.
Photo Album: A nice photo album for storing all the photos taken along your adventure.
GB Sounds: A music player that allows you to listen to nostalgic songs. It's operated with a single switch.
Tidal Bell: A very old-fashioned bell that makes a gentle ringing.
Rage Candy Bar: A famous Mahogany Town candy tourists like to buy and take home. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.
Data Card 01: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many victories you've had.
Data Card 02: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many losses you've had.
Data Card 03: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have dashed.
Data Card 04: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have jumped.
Data Card 05: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won the Hurdle Dash.
Data Card 06: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won the Relay Run.
Data Card 07: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Pennant Capture.
Data Card 08: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Block Smash.
Data Card 09: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Disc Catch.
Data Card 10: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Snow Throw.
Data Card 11: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many points your Pokémon scored.
Data Card 12: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have failed.
Data Card 13: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon impeded themselves.
Data Card 14: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have tackled.
Data Card 15: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon have fallen down.
Data Card 16: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Ring Drop.
Data Card 17: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Lamp Jump.
Data Card 18: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Circle Push.
Data Card 19: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many Link Pokéathlon wins you've had.
Data Card 20: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many Link Pokéathlon losses you've had.
Data Card 21: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won an event.
Data Card 22: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've lost an event.
Data Card 23: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've switched Pokémon.
Data Card 24: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've won Goal Roll.
Data Card 25: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times your Pokémon won individual prizes.
Data Card 26: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how many times you've instructed your Pokémon.
Data Card 27: It holds Pokéathlon records. It's a card that shows how much time you've spent in the Pokéathlon.
Jade Orb: A shiny green orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
Lock Capsule: A sturdy Capsule that can only be opened with a special key.
Red Orb: A shiny red orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
Blue Orb: A shiny blue orb that is said to have a legend and has a deep connection with the Hoenn region.
Enigma Stone: A crystal ball that was excavated from the ground. A very beautiful stone that is covered with bits of rock and earth.
Prism Scale: A mysterious scale that evolves a certain Pokémon. It shines in rainbow colors.
Eviolite: A mysterious evolutionary lump. When held, it raises the Defense and Sp. Def of a Pokémon that can still evolve.
Float Stone: A very light stone. It reduces the weight of a Pokémon when held.
Rocky Helmet: If the holder of this item takes damage, the attacker will also be damaged upon contact.
Air Balloon: When held by a Pokémon, the Pokémon will float into the air. When the holder is attacked, this item will burst.
Red Card: A card with a mysterious power. When the holder is struck by a foe, the attacker is removed from battle.
Ring Target: Moves that would otherwise have no effect will land on the Pokémon that holds it.
Binding Band: A band that increases the power of binding moves when held.
Absorb Bulb: A consumable bulb. If the holder is hit by a Water-type move, its Sp. Atk will rise.
Cell Battery: A consumable battery. If the holder is hit by an Electric-type move, its Attack will rise.
Eject Button: If the holder is hit by an attack, it will switch with another Pokémon in your party.
Fire Gem: A gem with an essence of fire. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fire-type move only once.
Water Gem: A gem with an essence of water. When held, it strengthens the power of a Water-type move only once.
Electric Gem: A gem with an essence of electricity. When held, it strengthens the power of an Electric-type move only once.
Grass Gem: A gem with an essence of nature. When held, it strengthens the power of a Grass-type move only once.
Ice Gem: A gem with an essence of ice. When held, it strengthens the power of an Ice-type move only once.
Fighting Gem: A gem with an essence of combat. When held, it strengthens the power of a Fighting-type move only once.
Poison Gem: A gem with an essence of poison. When held, it strengthens the power of a Poison-type move only once.
Ground Gem: A gem with an essence of land. When held, it strengthens the power of a Ground-type move only once.
Flying Gem: A gem with an essence of air. When held, it strengthens the power of a Flying-type move only once.
Psychic Gem: A gem with an essence of the mind. When held, it strengthens the power of a Psychic-type move only once.
Bug Gem: A gem with an insect-like essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Bug-type move only once.
Rock Gem: A gem with an essence of rock. When held, it strengthens the power of a Rock-type move only once.
Ghost Gem: A gem with a spectral essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Ghost-type move only once.
Dragon Gem: A gem with a draconic essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Dragon-type move only once.
Dark Gem: A gem with an essence of darkness. When held, it strengthens the power of a Dark-type move only once.
Steel Gem: A gem with an essence of steel. When held, it strengthens the power of a Steel-type move only once.
Normal Gem: A gem with an ordinary essence. When held, it strengthens the power of a Normal-type move only once.
Health Wing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base HP of a single Pokémon.
Muscle Wing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.
Resist Wing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.
Genius Wing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Sp. Atk stat of a single Pokémon.
Clever Wing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Sp. Def stat of a single Pokémon.
Swift Wing: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.
Pretty Wing: Though this feather is beautiful, it's just a regular feather and has no effect on Pokémon.
Cover Fossil: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that lived in the sea in ancient times. It appears to be part of its back.
Plume Fossil: A fossil of an ancient Pokémon that flew in the sky in ancient times. It appears to be part of its wing.
Liberty Pass: A special pass to go to Liberty Garden. Board the ship in Castelia City.
Pass Orb: A mysterious orb containing the power of the Unova region, to be used when generating Pass Power.
Dream Ball: A special Poké Ball that appears out of nowhere in a bag at the Entree Forest. It can catch any Pokémon.
Poké Toy: An item that attracts Pokémon. Use it to flee from any battle with a wild Pokémon.
Prop Case: A lovely case to store colorful Props for your Pokémon to wear in a musical.
Dragon Skull: A skull of a Pokémon which was said to have braved the angry waters to fly around the world.
Balm Mushroom: A rare mushroom which gives off a nice fragrance. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Big Nugget: A big nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Pearl String: Very large pearls that sparkle in a pretty silver color. A maniac will buy them for a high price.
Comet Shard: A shard which fell to the ground when a comet approached. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Relic Copper: A copper coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Relic Silver: A silver coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Relic Gold: A gold coin used in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Relic Vase: A vase made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Relic Band: A bracelet made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Relic Statue: A stone figure made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Relic Crown: A crown made in a civilization about 3,000 years ago. A maniac will buy it for a high price.
Casteliacone: Castelia City's specialty, soft-serve ice cream. It heals all the status problems of a single Pokémon.

X Defend 2: It sharply raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Attack 2: It sharply raises the Attack stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Accuracy 2: It sharply raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Speed 3: It drastically raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Special 3: It drastically raises the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Sp. Def 3: It drastically raises the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Defend 3: It drastically raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Attack 3: It drastically raises the Attack stat of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Accuracy 3: It drastically raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Speed 6: It raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Special 6: It raises the Sp. Atk stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Sp. Def 6: It raises the Sp. Def stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Defend 6: It raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Attack 6: It raises the Attack stat of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
X Accuracy 6: It raises the accuracy of a Pokémon in battle immensely. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
Ability Urge: When used, it activates the Ability of an ally Pokémon.
Item Drop: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to drop a held item.
Item Urge: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to use its held item.
Reset Urge: When used, it restores any stat changes of an ally Pokémon.
Dire Hit 3: It can be used many times to greatly raise a Pokémon's critical-hit ratio. It wears off if the Pokémon is withdrawn.
Light Stone: Reshiram's body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.
Dark Stone: Zekrom's body was destroyed and changed into this stone. It is said to be waiting for the emergence of a hero.
Xtransceiver: A high-tech transceiver with a camera function. It allows up to four-way calls.
Old Sea Map: A faded sea chart that shows the way to a certain island. N found it on his travels.
Gram 1: An important letter which Wingull delivers.
Gram 2: An important letter which Wingull delivers.
Gram 3: An important letter which Wingull delivers.
Medal Box: A box-shaped machine that stores Medals and Medal information.
DNA Splicers: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.
Permit: A permit needed to enter the Nature Preserve. Only a few know about this place.
Oval Charm: An oval charm said to increase the chance of Eggs being found at the Day Care.
Shiny Charm: A shiny charm said to increase the chance of finding a Shiny Pokémon.
Plasma Card: A card key needed to enter the password inside the Plasma Frigate.
Grubby Hanky: A handkerchief dropped by a regular at Café Warehouse. It smells faintly like a Pokémon.
Colress Machine: A special device that wrings out the potential of Pokémon. It is an imperfect prototype.
Dropped Item: The Xtransceiver found at the Nimbasa City amusement park. It seems it belongs to a boy.
Reveal Glass: A glass that reveals the truth. It is a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon back to its original shape.
